name: Timeout
flavour: Stop the clock. Leave the floor.
text: Every 20 s a Timeout lands 3 m beside him and waits 30 s; one at a time. Step on it: he leaps clear of the crowd, untouchable for 0.8 s, and the crowd he left stands slowed 50% for 2 s.
art_prompt: a chrome referee's whistle on a purple lanyard with a white 'T' timeout hand-sign burst behind it
